678-5865-8249.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has lost life this turn
678-5865-8249.description:
Cast Flamecache Gecko by paying its mana cost.
When Flamecache Gecko enters, it triggers, adding {B}{R}.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Flamecache Gecko.
When Flamecache Gecko dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Flamecache Gecko from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager.
Repeat.

1580-4871-5670-7452.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
1580-4871-5670-7452.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Cauldron of Essence and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

4490-7807--210.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4490-7807--210.description:
Give Shalai and Hallar lifelink, if needed.
Gain life.
Dr. Beverly Crusher triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Shalai and Hallar triggers, dealing damage to an opponent and causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 3.
4490-7807--210.notes: Additional mana and/or prerequisites may be required depending on the method used to give Shalai and Hallar lifelink.

147-4454-5686.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-4454-5686.description:
Cast Bond of Revival by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Bond of Revival.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, creating a Blood token.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Bond of Revival
Resolve the Bond of Revival copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

728-3560-5972.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
728-3560-5972.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Archon of Sun's Grace triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

1170-5131-6797-7650--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-5131-6797-7650--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Bilbo.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Repeat.

1987-3227-6747.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1987-3227-6747.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
1987-3227-6747.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Scrivener.
When Scrivener enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-3227-6747.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

1628-2099-3490-7426.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
1628-2099-3490-7426.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing another artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Berta triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Berta and Animation Module trigger.
Resolve the Berta trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat

3605-4812-5987-6798.description:
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Animate Dead enters, it trigger, returning Angel of Indemnity from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Animate Dead to it.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, targeting Dance of the Dead.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Angel of Indemnity.
Resolve the Angel of Indemnity trigger, returning Dance of the Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dance of the Dead enters, it trigger, returning Angel of Indemnity from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Dance of the Dead to it.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, targeting Animate Dead.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Angel of Indemnity.
Resolve the Angel of Indemnity trigger, returning Animate Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

141-413-7364.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-413-7364.description:
Cast Continue? by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Continue?
Resolve the Continue? copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-413-7364.notes: You can sacrifice up to three additional creatures and return them using Continue? each loop.

457-1329-1477-7340.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Sewer-veillance Cam from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Sewer-veillance Cam from your graveyard by paying {U}.
When Sewer-veillance Cam enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Sewer-veillance Cam, adding {U}.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Sewer-veillance Cam.
Sewer-veillance Cam triggers, untapping a creature you control.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Repeat.
457-1329-1477-7340.notes: If you control an artifact creature, it can be untapped by the second Sewer-veillance Cam trigger, and then tapped via Urza to get infinite blue mana. Once you have infinite blue mana, you can either use it for Urza's second ability and/or to activate Sewer-veillance Cam's ability to draw cards.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4585-5256-6972.easyPrerequisites: There are at least three total creatures on the battlefield.
4585-5256-6972.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Custodi Soulbinders.
When Custodi Soulbinders dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

2438-4311-4871-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
2438-4311-4871-5220.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

321-399-944-2475-6707.description:
Cast Metallic Sliver by paying {0}.
When Metallic Sliver enters, it triggers, dealing 1 damage to target player or planeswalker and causing you to gain 2 life due to its ability and lifelink.
Activate Metallic Sliver by paying 2 life, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4875-5231-5310-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Repeat from step 3.
4875-5231-5310-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a film counter on it

57-1753-4846-6924.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-1753-4846-6924.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Peter Parker's Camera by paying {2}, tapping and removing a film counter from it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2060-3490-6792.description:
Cast Animation Module by paying {1}.
When Animation Module enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Animation Module triggers. Holding priority, activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Repeat from step 3.

3532-5078-5240-6747.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional artifact.
3532-5078-5240-6747.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Oneirophage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

659-4381-4613-6965.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
659-4381-4613-6965.description:
Activate a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it, creating a 1/1 red Goblin creature token.
The 1/1 Goblin token enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Grumgully's ability.
Repeat.

1987-2104-4423-6927.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
1987-2104-4423-6927.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Damage Control Crew.
When Damage Control Crew and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Damage Control Crew trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Temporal Manipulation during your draw step.
Repeat.

3234-3293-5413-6798.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
3234-3293-5413-6798.description:
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat
3234-3293-5413-6798.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

4264-5299-5466.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Altered Ego
4264-5299-5466.description:
Cast Altered Ego by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Put Altered Ego into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Altered Ego's first ability and second ability trigger, along with Rakdos Joins Up's second ability.
Resolve Altered Ego's second trigger and Rakdos Joins Up's trigger, dealing damage to target opponent.
Resolve Altered Ego's first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Repeat from step 2.

804-4659-5365.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Clue token.
Sakashima the Impostor on the battlefield as a copy of Lonis.
804-4659-5365.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Clue, adding {C}{C}.
Lonis and Sakashima the Impostor's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Sakashima the Impostor.
Sakashima the Impostor's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis' first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Repeat.
804-4659-5365.notes:
You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead sacrifice the Clues to their own abilities

277-880-3585.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
277-880-3585.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Greensleeves and Tiller Engine trigger.
Resolve the Greensleeves trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping the land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

549-3259-3480-5953.easyPrerequisites: Breath of Fury attached to any other creature you control.
549-3259-3480-5953.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
549-3259-3480-5953.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Aya of Alexandria trigger.
Resolve the Aya of Alexandria trigger, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2232-2931-5654-5655.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five Auras.
2232-2931-5654-5655.description:
Cast Faceless One by paying {0} due to Pearl-Ear.
When Faceless One enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Ugin's Mastery from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Ugin's Mastery by paying {0} due to Pearl-Ear.
When Ugin's Mastery enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Faceless One from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

204-392-1858-2056-3480.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one white permanent.
204-392-1858-2056-3480.description:
Cast View from Above by paying {1}{U}.
Birgi and Saheeli trigger.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Saheeli trigger, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the Servo by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast an instant or sorcery spell, or to gain a Class level.
Repeat.

618-3957-4613-4716.notablePrerequisites: Famished Paladin has at least one +1/+1 counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
618-3957-4613-4716.description:
Activate Famished Paladin using Kiki-Jiki's ability by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself with haste.
When the Famished Paladin token enters the battlefield, Prosperous Innkeeper's second ability triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Each Famished Paladin you control triggers, untapping themselves.
Repeat.
You may also target any nonlegendary creature you control, including Prosperous Innkeeper.

560-876-2034-2703.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Myr Propagator.
Activate Myr Propagator by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a token copy of itself and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the tapped Myr Propagator and the Soldier, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Myr Propagator and/or Soldier tokens.

215-4050-4729-4772-5176.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven artifacts.
215-4050-4729-4772-5176.description:
Cast Myr Enforcer by paying {0}.
Radagast triggers, creating two 3/3 Beast creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Beasts, adding {1}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Myr Enforcer from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2594-2634-4821.notablePrerequisites: Nonland permanents you control can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{R}.
2594-2634-4821.description:
Activate all mana-producing nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{R}.
Activate Winding Canyons's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, allowing you to cast creature spells this turn as though they had flash.
Cast Dramatic Reversal by paying {1}{U}.
Activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it to your hand, copying Dramatic Reversal.
Resolve the Dramatic Reversal copy, untapping all nonland permanents you control.
Activate all mana-producing nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Rootha by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 4.
If nonland permanents you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{R}, this combo nets infinite mana.

273-3944-4763.description:
Activate Shuko's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Blood Pet.
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, Koll triggers, returning Blood Pet from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Blood Pet by paying {B}.
Repeat.

2073-2866-3180-4659.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken noncreature artifact with mana value one or less.
2073-2866-3180-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the nontoken noncreature artifact, adding {C}{C}.
Scrap Trawler triggers, returning Chamber Sentry from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning the noncreature artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cast Chamber Sentry by paying {0}.
Chamber Sentry enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Scrap Trawler and Salvaging Station trigger.
Resolve the Salvaging Station trigger, untapping itself.
Resolve the Scrap Trawler trigger, returning nothing from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

876-2410-4777-5129.description:
Cast Silver Myr by paying {2}.
Silver Myr enters the battlefield, triggering Mirrorworks, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Silver Myr.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to a Silver Myr.
Activate the Silver Myr by tapping it, adding {U}.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Cast Myr Galvanizer by paying {3}.
Myr Galvanizer enters the battlefield, triggering Mirrorworks, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Myr Galvanizer.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to a Myr Galvanizer.
Activate the Myr Galvanizer by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping all other Myr you control.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to a Silver Myr.
Activate the Silver Myr by tapping it, adding {U}.
Repeat from step 10 one additional time.
Repeat from step 8.

1912-4289-4385-5153.notablePrerequisites: Sunstrike Legionnaire does not have summoning sickness.
1912-4289-4385-5153.description:
Tap Sunstrike Legionnaire to add {1}.
Pay {1} to create a 1/1 Sliver token.
Sunstrike Legionnaire triggers, untapping.
Repeat.
